ir.evidence: A black IR diode is visible on the breadboard, located in the upper part of the component cluster.

ir_pin.evidence: The wire connected to the IR diode row (the one not connected to GND) leads to pin 9 on the Arduino.

fire_led.evidence: A red LED is visible on the breadboard below the IR diode.

fire_resistor.evidence: A resistor is connected in the same row as the cathode of the red LED.

led_polarity.evidence: The red LED is oriented correctly with the anode (longer leg) connected to the signal path and the cathode connected to the resistor/GND path.

buzzer.evidence: A black circular buzzer is visible on the breadboard.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The GND wire from the Arduino connects to the blue negative rail on the breadboard.
